title: Ratiba ya Chanjo za Watoto Child Immunisation Schedule

headings.text: Ratiba ya Chanjo za Watoto Child Immunisation Schedule

key_sentences: Chanjo humkinga mtoto dhidi ya magonjwa hatari.
Mlete mtoto wako kliniki kwa wakati kulingana na ratiba hii.
Vaccines protect your child against dangerous diseases.
Bring your child to the clinic on time according to this schedule.
Hali hii kwa kawaida huisha baada ya siku moja au mbili.
This usually goes away after one or two days.
All vaccines are free of charge.

notes: The title is printed on two lines, Swahili above and the English translation below in italics; the title string joins them with one space. The opening paragraphs sit side by side, Swahili left and English right; reading order is Swahili first. Age cells span rows ('Wakati wa kuzaliwa / At birth' over 2 rows, 'Wiki 6 / 6 weeks' over 4, 'Wiki 14 / 14 weeks' over 2) and are repeated in every covered row. Swahili clock times count from 6 a.m. ('saa 2 asubuhi' = 8 a.m.); this is content, not an error. The top line 'ZAHANATI YA MWEMBENI · MWEMBENI DISPENSARY' is an organisation line, not a heading or furniture.
